staff.name: Elira Sakurai
staff.title: The Domina
staff.description: Founder of The Midnight Eclipse. Once Garlean, now untethered from empire or mercy, Elira turned to crime, control, and experimentation after watching her homeland rot. Discovery is her doctrine; dominance, her method. Her use of thralls serves many purposes—most of which she does not explain, and never justifies.
